svg.text: Glass bar: 80% opaque (light), 90% (dark), measured over worst-case content by tools/glass.py. All tab labels at full text colour; selected tab = solid pill.
No count or badge on the queue (CONF-1); no option pre-selected (CONF-3); ratings also as text (A11Y-2); no pins. Fonts are stand-ins.
